intro: This unit is about owning a car — costs, traffic, freedom. Grammar: (1) 早知道……，还不如…… “if I'd known…, I'd rather have…” (regret); (2) 想……就…… “do whatever you like”; (3) 反正 “anyway, in any case”. Answers marked “model answer” were written for this sheet.

key_sentences.zh: 早知道这样，咱们还不如坐地铁呢。
key_sentences.py: Zǎo zhīdào zhèyàng, zánmen hái bùrú zuò dìtiě ne.
key_sentences.en: If we'd known it would be like this, we'd have been better off taking the subway.

key_sentences.zh: 买辆车，周末的时候咱们想去哪儿玩儿就去哪儿玩儿。
key_sentences.py: Mǎi liàng chē, zhōumò de shíhou zánmen xiǎng qù nǎr wánr jiù qù nǎr wánr.
key_sentences.en: If we buy a car, at weekends we can go wherever we like.
Anyway, I don't want to buy one.

key_sentences.zh: 咱们没有必要非得买车。
key_sentences.py: Zánmen méiyǒu bìyào fēiděi mǎi chē.
key_sentences.en: There's no need for us to buy a car.

title.en: The usage of 早知道……，还不如……

body.zh: 该句型表示一种虚拟语气，表明说话者很后悔。例如：
body.en: This pattern expresses the subjunctive mood: the speaker deeply regrets something, e.g.,

body.zh: 早知道 + （没想到的情况），（主语）+ 还不如 + （本来应该做的事）
body.py: zǎo zhīdào + (méi xiǎngdào de qíngkuàng), (zhǔyǔ) + hái bùrú + (běnlái yīnggāi zuò de shì)
body.en: if I'd known + (what turned out), (subject) + would rather have + (the better choice)

body.zh: 早知道这个电影这么没意思，还不如在家睡觉。
body.py: Zǎo zhīdào zhège diànyǐng zhème méi yìsi, hái bùrú zài jiā shuì jiào.
body.en: If I'd known this film was so boring, I'd have stayed home and slept.

body.zh: 早知道这家饭馆的菜这么难吃，咱们还不如去别家。
body.py: Zǎo zhīdào zhè jiā fànguǎn de cài zhème nánchī, zánmen hái bùrú qù bié jiā.
body.en: If we'd known the food here was this bad, we'd have gone somewhere else.
早知道 starts the sentence; 还不如 goes right before the better option: ✓ 早知道这个电影这么无聊，还不如在家看电视. ✗ 这个电影早知道…，在家还不如看电视.

body.zh: 该句型表示可以随心所欲做某事。例如：
body.en: This pattern means you can do whatever you please, e.g.,

body.zh: 想 + 动词 + 疑问词……就 + 动词 + 同一疑问词……
body.py: xiǎng + dòngcí + yíwèncí…… jiù + dòngcí + tóng yí yíwèncí……
body.en: want to + verb + where/what/how… then + same verb + same question word (= whatever / wherever)

body.zh: 放假了，你想去哪儿玩儿就去哪儿玩儿。
body.py: Fàng jià le, nǐ xiǎng qù nǎr wánr jiù qù nǎr wánr.
body.en: It's the holidays — go wherever you like.

body.zh: 要想减肥，你不能总是想吃什么就吃什么。
body.py: Yào xiǎng jiǎn féi, nǐ bù néng zǒngshì xiǎng chī shénme jiù chī shénme.
body.en: If you want to lose weight, you can't always eat whatever you feel like.
Repeat the same verb and question word on both sides: ✓ 想去哪儿就去哪儿 / ✓ 想怎么去就怎么去. ✗ 想去哪儿就去我去.

body.zh: “反正”表示不管在什么条件下，做法、结论不会改变。例如：
body.en: “反正” means that whatever the conditions, the action or conclusion won't change, e.g.,

body.zh: 不管……，反正 + 主语 + 决定／结论
body.en: no matter…, anyway + subject + (decision that won't change)

body.zh: 不管你们怎么说，反正我不同意。
body.py: Bùguǎn nǐmen zěnme shuō, fǎnzhèng wǒ bù tóngyì.
body.en: Whatever you say, I don't agree anyway.

body.zh: 不管刮风还是下雨，反正我要去。
body.py: Bùguǎn guā fēng háishi xià yǔ, fǎnzhèng wǒ yào qù.
body.en: Wind or rain, I'm going anyway.
反正 comes before the subject of the decision, at the start of the clause: ✓ 反正我不会改变主意的. ✗ 我不会改变反正主意的.

instructions.zh: 根据图片所给的信息，用“早知道……还不如……”完成句子。
instructions.en: Complete a sentence for each picture using “早知道……还不如……”.

body.en: Example: a couple sheltering under an umbrella on the Great Wall in the rain, daydreaming of watching TV on the sofa.

body.zh: 早知道周末下雨，我们还不如在家看电视。
body.py: Zǎo zhīdào zhōumò xià yǔ, wǒmen hái bùrú zài jiā kàn diànshì.
body.en: If we'd known it would rain at the weekend, we'd have stayed home watching TV.

items.picture: Passengers squashed together on a packed bus; one daydreams of riding in a car.

answer.zh: 早知道公共汽车上这么挤，还不如坐出租车。
answer.py: Zǎo zhīdào gōnggòng qìchē shang zhème jǐ, hái bùrú zuò chūzūchē.
answer.en: If I'd known the bus would be this packed, I'd have taken a taxi. (model answer)

items.picture: A man shivering in the snow, daydreaming of sitting warm indoors.

answer.zh: 早知道今天这么冷，还不如在家待着。
answer.py: Zǎo zhīdào jīntiān zhème lěng, hái bùrú zài jiā dāizhe.
answer.en: If I'd known it would be this cold, I'd have stayed at home. (model answer)

items.picture: A woman grimacing at her meal, daydreaming of other dishes.

answer.zh: 早知道这儿的菜这么难吃，还不如在家自己做。
answer.py: Zǎo zhīdào zhèr de cài zhème nánchī, hái bùrú zài jiā zìjǐ zuò.
answer.en: If I'd known the food here was this bad, I'd have cooked at home. (model answer)

items.picture: A couple in a restaurant; the man stares in shock at the bill.

answer.zh: 早知道这家饭馆这么贵，咱们还不如去吃快餐。
answer.py: Zǎo zhīdào zhè jiā fànguǎn zhème guì, zánmen hái bùrú qù chī kuàicān.
answer.en: If we'd known this restaurant was so expensive, we'd have gone for fast food. (model answer)

prompt.zh: 你有没有做过让你后悔的事，用“早知道……还不如……”说一说自己的经历。
prompt.en: Group work: talk about something you regret, using 早知道……还不如……

answer.zh: 早知道学汉语这么有意思，我还不如早点儿开始学。
answer.py: Zǎo zhīdào xué Hànyǔ zhème yǒu yìsi, wǒ hái bùrú zǎo diǎnr kāishǐ xué.
answer.en: If I'd known learning Chinese was this much fun, I'd have started sooner. (model answer)

instructions.zh: 你有没有可以随心所欲的时候，用“想……就……”说一说。
instructions.en: Are there times you can do whatever you want? Talk about them with “想……就……”.

body.zh: 放假的时候我想睡到几点就睡到几点。
body.py: Fàng jià de shíhou wǒ xiǎng shuì dào jǐ diǎn jiù shuì dào jǐ diǎn.
body.en: On holiday I sleep until whatever time I like.

answer.zh: 周末我想做什么就做什么。
answer.en: At the weekend I do whatever I like. (model answer)

prompt.en: When you have your own car…

answer.zh: 有了车，我想什么时候走就什么时候走。
answer.py: Yǒule chē, wǒ xiǎng shénme shíhou zǒu jiù shénme shíhou zǒu.
answer.en: With a car, I can leave whenever I want. (model answer)

answer.zh: 在自助餐厅，你想吃多少就吃多少。
answer.py: Zài zìzhù cāntīng, nǐ xiǎng chī duōshao jiù chī duōshao.
answer.en: At a buffet, you can eat as much as you like. (model answer)

instructions.zh: 你有没有不管在什么情况下都不会改变的做法、想法或决定？用“反正”和你的朋友说一说。
instructions.en: Is there something you'd never change your mind about, whatever happens? Tell your friends using “反正”.

body.zh: 不管刮风还是下雨，反正我要去。
body.py: Bùguǎn guā fēng háishi xià yǔ, fǎnzhèng wǒ yào qù.
body.en: Wind or rain, I'm going anyway.

answer.zh: 不管别人怎么说，反正我不买车。
answer.en: Whatever others say, I'm not buying a car anyway. (model answer)

answer.zh: 不管工作多忙，反正我每天都要跑步。
answer.en: However busy work is, I run every day regardless. (model answer)

answer.zh: 不管多贵，反正我明年一定要去中国。
answer.en: However expensive it is, I'm definitely going to China next year. (model answer)

instructions.zh: 在正确的句子或合适的答句前打✓，看看你语法学得怎么样。
instructions.en: Tick ✓ the right sentence or answer to check how well you have learned the grammar.

options.zh: 早知道这个电影这么无聊，还不如在家看电视。
options.py: Zǎo zhīdào zhège diànyǐng zhème wúliáo, hái bùrú zài jiā kàn diànshì.

options.zh: 这个电影早知道这么无聊，在家还不如看电视。
options.py: Zhège diànyǐng zǎo zhīdào zhème wúliáo, zài jiā hái bùrú kàn diànshì.

questions.explain: 早知道 opens the sentence; 还不如 goes before the whole better option. (grammar note 1)

options.zh: 我想去哪儿就去哪儿，不关你事。
options.py: Wǒ xiǎng qù nǎr jiù qù nǎr, bù guān nǐ shì.

options.zh: 我想去哪儿就去我去，不关你事。
options.py: Wǒ xiǎng qù nǎr jiù qù wǒ qù, bù guān nǐ shì.

questions.explain: Repeat the same verb + question word: 想去哪儿就去哪儿. (grammar note 2)

options.zh: 早知道你不喜欢吃中餐，我们还不如去吃西餐。
options.py: Zǎo zhīdào nǐ bù xǐhuan chī zhōngcān, wǒmen hái bùrú qù chī xīcān.

options.zh: 你早知道不喜欢吃中餐，我们去吃还不如西餐。
options.py: Nǐ zǎo zhīdào bù xǐhuan chī zhōngcān, wǒmen qù chī hái bùrú xīcān.

questions.explain: 早知道 + what you didn't know; 还不如 + the better choice. (grammar note 1)

options.zh: 不管你怎么说，反正我不会改变主意的。
options.py: Bùguǎn nǐ zěnme shuō, fǎnzhèng wǒ bú huì gǎibiàn zhǔyi de.

options.zh: 不管你怎么说，我不会改变反正主意的。
options.py: Bùguǎn nǐ zěnme shuō, wǒ bú huì gǎibiàn fǎnzhèng zhǔyi de.

questions.explain: 反正 opens the clause with the unchanging decision. (grammar note 3)

options.zh: 你想怎么去就怎么去，我听你的。
options.py: Nǐ xiǎng zěnme qù jiù zěnme qù, wǒ tīng nǐ de.

options.zh: 你想怎么去我就怎么听你的去。
options.py: Nǐ xiǎng zěnme qù wǒ jiù zěnme tīng nǐ de qù.

questions.explain: 想怎么去就怎么去 — same verb and question word on both sides. (grammar note 2)

quiz.answer_note: Book's scoring: all right — 太棒了！. Missed Q4 — review 反正 (note 3). Missed Q2 or Q5 — review 想……就…… (note 2). Missed Q1 or Q3 — review 早知道……还不如…… (note 1).
